caveats: This is based directly on the user-provided JWST FITS archive, independently streamed in a local analysis environment. The binary archive itself has not been uploaded to the GitHub repository.
Value=1 is interpreted as a masked pixel; official mask-value semantics should be cross-checked before publication.
Masked per-tile sum double counts overlapping tile regions; it is not unique-sky, WHT-intersection, or dropout-selection-matched area.
The 125-source results are center-pixel and limited-neighborhood tests. They are not PSF or segmentation aperture overlap flags.
A 1.02 arcsec square per-axis search was used to safely enclose a 1.0 arcsec radius. Only candidates with Euclidean distance <=1.0 arcsec are listed in the 1.0-arcsec set.
No 7GB WHT redownload and no MAST requery performed. Existing >=365d archive-red opportunity remains approx. 59.5 percent, not astrometric completeness.
